commits.subject: fix(tests): budget CLI coverage from parsed options
commits.body:
fix(tests): budget CLI coverage from parsed options

Use the pinned Vitest parser for coverage and shard flags. Keep ordinary CLI workers at 384 MiB and covered workers at the tested 512 MiB with unchanged concurrency. Retain complete coverage and add actual-config regressions for false, provider-only and spaced-shard options.

Validation: 27 focused cases; 16 covered cases with CLI preloaded; 5 docs checks; typecheck/lint; exact discovery of 1578 files. Measured covered control: 22.18s elapsed, 46.52s CPU, about 2.33 GiB sampled summed process-family RSS on macOS arm64. Full Linux CI pending. No runtime/device verification claimed.

Fixes #4960

commits.subject: fix(setup): edit the duplicate JSON member that clients read (#4957)
commits.body:
fix(setup): edit the duplicate JSON member that clients read (#4957)

JSON.parse, JSONC parse, and native Claude Code keep the last duplicate
object member, and parseClientConfiguration therefore validates the last
one. The shared setup/uninstall serializer instead edited text through
jsonc-parser's modify and findNodeAtLocation, which select the first
matching member, so setup and uninstall on configurations with repeated
server tables or rea members wrote into a shadowed member and failed
readback.

Locate every JSON text edit by the effective (last) member in one place,
replacing the first-member modify path. Removing an effective member
that shadows an earlier duplicate would activate that duplicate, whatever
its ownership, so the serializer now returns a tagged shadowed_member
failure and setup and uninstall refuse before writing a backup or the
configuration.

Fixes #4952
